arithmetic_notes: All counts are seeded for the morning of the demo's Tuesday. Coffee: one bag on hand until Lisa uses the last of it at 7:05 AM, so it reads out on the record and on Briefing. Dishwasher tablets: 9 on hand at one a day lasts 9 days, with 3 days' lead, so they are not due yet. Paper towels: 3 rolls at 0.3 a day lasts 10 days, 2 days' lead. Dish soap: 1 bottle at 0.1 a day lasts 10 days, 3 days' lead. Toilet paper is not a tracked item; the 6:30 PM note about it is told to the house and waits for anyone to close it.
